row.phrase: One row is one galaxy, measured from its image on one of the plates in the archive's survey collection.

blocks.title: Measured on the plate
blocks.blurb: Read off each galaxy's image on its glass photographic plate.

columns.name: galaxy
columns.meaning: The galaxy's catalogue code: G, the year its plate was taken, and a catalogue number. Each galaxy appears once.

columns.name: record
columns.meaning: Which part of the catalogue the galaxy belongs to.

levels.training: galaxies from the earlier survey plates, used to build (train) the model
levels.held back: galaxies from the later survey plates, kept aside and never used to build the model, to test how well it predicts galaxies it has not seen

columns.name: elliptical
columns.meaning: Whether the galaxy is an elliptical (yes) or a spiral (no).

columns.name: color_index
columns.meaning: The galaxy's color as a color index: larger numbers are redder.

columns.name: concentration
columns.meaning: How tightly the galaxy's light is gathered toward its center: the radius holding nearly all of its light divided by the radius holding half of it.

columns.name: axis_ratio
columns.meaning: How round the galaxy's image looks: its short axis divided by its long axis (a perfect circle scores one).

columns.name: apparent_size_arcsec
columns.meaning: How large the galaxy's image is on the plate.

columns.name: exposure_minutes
columns.meaning: How long the plate was exposed to the sky.
